API 510 Pressure Vessel Inspector Training

Comprehensive training for ASME Boiler & Pressure Vessel Code compliance. Risk-based inspection (RBI) methodology. Hands-on labs with real equipment. Industry-required credential for refineries, petrochemical plants, and oil & gas operations.

API 510 certification is essential for career advancement in oil & gas, petrochemical, and refining industries.

Comprehensive coverage of pressure vessel inspection, ASME code, and practical assessment techniques.

One of the following is required for API 510 certification:

Pressure vessel inspectors for production platforms, gathering systems, and compression facilities.

In-service inspection of process vessels, reactors, and distillation columns. Essential role during turnarounds.

Continuous inspection of chemical processing vessels and compliance with API 510 standards.

Work for specialized inspection companies serving multiple refinery and petrochemical clients.

API 510 certification opens doors in refineries, petrochemical plants, and major oil & gas companies worldwide.

Atlantis NDT runs API 510 Pressure Vessel Inspector exam prep across all major energy hubs. ADNOC, Saudi Aramco, Petronas, Reliance, and Shell-approved instructors.

Key points covered

  • API 510 certification is mandatory for pressure vessel inspectors in oil & gas, petrochemical, and refineries.
  • Certified API 510 inspectors command premium salaries: $75,000-$120,000+ annually depending on experience and location.
  • Work for major oil companies, petrochemical plants, inspection contractors, and consulting firms across the USA.
  • Learn from instructors with 20+ years of pressure vessel inspection and API 510 certification experience.
  • Active API 570 (Piping Inspector) or API 653 (Tank Inspector) certification, OR
  • ASNT Level III certification in any NDT method with 3 years of vessel inspection experience
